It's already delivered real results, and it matters more every quarter as deal volume grows and Moss moves into bigger, more complex deals. What makes the role unusual is that the desk already runs on AI. An agent picks up each request, pulls the deal's scoring and call history, calculates margin, and drafts a reasoned reply; you approve, correct, or overrule it.
